card.title: The deepest known point of the seabed

body.question: The Challenger Deep is the deepest known point of Earth's seabed. About how deep is it below sea level, in metres?
body.reveal: The Challenger Deep is located at the southern end of the Mariana Trench, in the western Pacific Ocean. Its maximum depth is 10,935 ± 6 m below sea level.

probes.question: About how deep is the Challenger Deep below sea level?
In which ocean is the Challenger Deep located?
